title: RosmarOps — State
description: Persisted state between runs. Owned by RosmarOps. Not intended for hand-editing. Used as the baseline for drift detection.

engine_version.description: SemVer of the RosmarOps binary that produced this state.

local_salt.description: Machine-local random salt (32 bytes, hex) used to key credential fingerprints and derive host_id. Never leaves the device; never written to reports or the graph.

consecutive_green.description: Resets to 0 on any non-green run. After 3+, rosmarops suggests biweekly cadence.

space_permission.description: True once the person approved connecting this computer to their online space (BV-137). The only space state kept here; the key and send credential live in the kit DPAPI blob. No network happens unless this is true.

send_problems_without_asking.description: The «Send the next ones without asking» checkbox (BV-210). When true, the program sends the problem list directly instead of asking. Off by default; the person can untick it at any time.

connect_offer_declined_at.description: When the person last declined («Not now») the connect offer at the end of a double-click review (BV-158, decision A). The offer is not shown again until 7 days after it. Optional.

usage.description: The person's answer about usage statistics (BV-256): whether they are on, when they answered, the version of the question's text they answered, and the random install id sent with them. Absent until the person answers. Optional.

knowledge_version.description: The product's knowledge base version when answered; another version asks again.

cursor.description: Cursor IDE: C1–C4 of CTO-56 §1.2. A question not asked is not stored; «I don't know» is unknown.

knowledge_version.description: The product's knowledge base version when answered; another version asks again.

grok-bot.description: Grok Bot: B0–B4 of CTO-56 §2.2, asked once per computer (BV-248 decision 8). A question not asked is not stored; «I don't know» is unknown.

declared.description: BV-248 (CTO-56 §5.1): the person's answers about settings RosmarOps cannot read at rest, per product, as stable codes. No free text, no machine name, nothing of the account. Optional.

vigil_binary_sha256.description: Hash of the RosmarOps binary as of the last `rosmarops baseline`.

config_sha256.description: Hash of rosmarops.config.json as of the last successful run.

binary_accepted_via.description: How the last change of the binary was accepted (CTO-37 F3, BV-222): by `rosmarops baseline`, confirmed in the console, by the administrator fingerprint list (0.12.0), or as a Microsoft Store update. Optional; absent in a state from before it.

config_source.description: Which configuration config_sha256 fingerprints: the person's config.json (user) or the company configuration company.json in use when the person has none (company). Optional; absent means user.

client.description: AI coding agent / MCP host. Examples: claude-code, cline, cursor, continue, aider, claude-desktop.

command_sha256.description: HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the local salt, of the concatenated (command + args + env keys): never a bare SHA-256, since the arguments may hold a secret.

destination_ref.description: Optional. The server's destination_ref (graph v2) when its allow_list.mcp_servers entry was accepted: the entry applies only while the server still points there (decision 2026-10-27, blindaje, B9).

package_sets_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonicalized set of {package_name}@{version} strings across all manifest files in the repo.

core_hooks_path.description: Value of git config core.hooksPath at baseline, if non-default.

shell_profile_sha256.description: PowerShell $PROFILE on Windows. ~/.zshrc or ~/.bashrc on Unix.

scheduled_tasks.description: Baseline of OS scheduled tasks: Windows Task Scheduler, macOS launchd, Linux systemd/cron.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical task definition.

npmrc_sha256.description: Hash of ~/.npmrc for registry override detection.
